diagnosis: Primary stacks show the Source API thread inside HttpBundleTransport.read -> verify_bundle (sequential raw-file loop, up to max_records=500 reads, each up to a 20s transport timeout) -> _pull_ordered -> run_frontier_item -> run_scheduled, while the controller waits on _request_json (30s urlopen timeout) from run_schedule_tick. Per-pull work was bounded by record count only, not elapsed time, so a steady pull could outlive the controller request. Which item and the latency distribution remain UNKNOWN.
change: CollectorBundleAdapter.read_budget_seconds (default 15s) is ONE operation deadline (_OP_DEADLINE ContextVar set in pull()) shared by the priority-latest bundle, the ordered sweep (checked between bundles as well as between raw reads, always >=1 read), index/status metadata and every HttpBundleTransport read, whose timeout is min(20s, remaining budget, 1s floor). A cut records verified_through; priority and ordered paths return only verified rows with the existing partial cursor/priority delivered count and complete=False; remaining work stays pending. Controller timeout not inflated; no new queue/service.
preserved: Every returned row's raw hash/size is still verified; cursor/ack only via existing delivery persistence; hash/size mismatches in later slices still raise; no_new_data requires fully verified boundary.

tests.result: 371 passed, 1 skipped (fake monotonic clock, no sleeping)
tests.old_fails_new_passes: New test_many_singleton_bundles_stay_within_budget_and_drain_without_loss[0,1800] (12 singleton bundles @5s; priority path with cadence 1800) and test_http_read_timeout_is_capped_by_remaining_operation_budget fail on the previous head (verified by reverting collector_bundle.py: 3 failed) and pass now.

limitations: Worst-case pull is about 15s budget + 1s timeout floor reads + post-deadline metadata (status read, 1s floor each); not a hard cap, but well under the 30s controller timeout.

Several connectors in one scheduler request each get their own 15s budget; controller overlap / in-flight-request reconciliation was not changed and no real endpoint/controller timeout-disconnect integration test was added (scheduler-level partial-cursor test from the prior head remains).
Priority-latest state is persisted by the caller's delivery; bare adapter tests replay priority rows idempotently.
services/source_ingestion/tests collection errors in test_l12_* modules are unrelated (missing deps); controller tests need uvicorn/asyncpg (ran in /tmp/bffvenv).
No hosted/VM/live verification; real latency distribution unknown.
